hub.headline: PHIGS is an international standard API for 3D graphics from the years before OpenGL.
hub.next: Point readers to CERN OpenPHIGS and record a repeatable build while its licence notices are reviewed.
hub.what_it_was: PHIGS (with its PHIGS+ extension) is a 3D graphics standard published as ISO/IEC 9592 and 9593. ISO/IEC 9592-3:1989 defined its clear-text archive encoding and is now withdrawn. NIST published validation tests for checking PHIGS implementations.
hub.what_survives: The standard text is not copied here, but ISO and NIST catalogue pages are public. OpenPHIGS reimplements PHIGS with an OpenGL backend; CERN keeps a version on GitHub with data-preservation extensions, under permissive X Consortium and Sun Microsystems licence notices.

name: PHIGS
summary: Public standards and validation-history record for PHIGS, with OpenPHIGS reimplementation pointers for revival research under license review.
